verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing platform with SDKs and a web app, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it lets users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The evidence pack documents no such opt-out control. The usage-event ingestion docs describe customers sending their own billing data to Metronome, which is a different capability from telemetry opt-out and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
